verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, and publishes an OpenAPI spec, so purchase via API is claimed. Contact editing is documented, but only in dashboard terms, not as API calls. Nameservers cannot be set at all: domains registered through Cloudflare must use Cloudflare nameservers, which community reports confirm. Missing for 10: documented API calls for contacts, configurable nameservers, and hands-on evidence of scripted end-to-end registration.
